from pathlib import Path
p=Path(wd)/'programs/task-44dbc45f.py'; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full row and column are separators; copy each cell pattern in one tile
    # to the matching position in every tile.
    sep_r = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_r is None or sep_c is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if r == sep_r: continue
        rr = r % sep_r if r > sep_r else r
        for c in range(w):
            if c == sep_c: continue
            cc = c % sep_c if c > sep_c else c
            # take pattern from the first tile at matching local coordinates
            value = grid[rr][cc]
            if value != 7:
                out[r][c] = value
            elif grid[r][c] != 7:
                out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_r = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    sep_c = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    rh, cw = sep_r, sep_c
    rstarts=[0,sep_r+1]; cstarts=[0,sep_c+1]
    tiles=[(rs,cs) for rs in rstarts for cs in cstarts]
    sr,sc=max(tiles,key=lambda t:sum(grid[t[0]+i][t[1]+j]!=7 for i in range(rh) for j in range(cw)))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs in rstarts:
      for cs in cstarts:
        for i in range(min(rh,h-rs)):
          for j in range(min(cw,w-cs)):
            v=grid[sr+i][sc+j]
            if v!=7: out[rs+i][cs+j]=v
    return out
